components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Electric yellow start action — full width, 72px, ink type.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { width: 100%; min-height: 72px; border: 0; border-radius: 20px; background: var(--cta, #ffe14a); color: var(--cta-ink, #141820); font-family: Sora, "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 1.45rem; letter-spacing: -0.02em; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; transition: transform 0.12s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), filter 0.12s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(0.96); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); filter: brightness(0.92); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #ffe14a); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action: transparent field, navy-line border.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { width: 100%; min-height: 72px; border: 2px solid var(--line, #3a5290); border-radius: 20px; background: transparent; color: var(--text, #f4f1ea); font-family: Sora, "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 1.45rem; letter-spacing: -0.02em; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; transition: transform 0.12s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), filter 0.12s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { filter: brightness(0.96); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: scale(0.97); filter: brightness(0.92); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #ffe14a); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Shelf-navy field with a 2px navy-line border.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; } .ds-field-label { display: block; font-family: Sora, "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.82rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--muted, #b7c4ea); margin-bottom: 6px; } .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 48px; border-radius: 14px; border: 2px solid var(--line, #3a5290); background: var(--bg-2, #1d3570); color: var(--text, #f4f1ea); padding: 0 14px; font-family: Sora, "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.05rem; caret-color: var(--cta, #ffe14a); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #8ea0d4; } .ds-input:hover { filter: brightness(1.06); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #ffe14a); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Color Pad
components.description: Fat player-color pad; selected state is a paper border plus drop.
components.css: .ds-pads { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 8px; } .ds-pad { width: 100%; height: 58px; border-radius: 16px; border: 3px solid transparent; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.12s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), filter 0.12s ease; } .ds-pad[data-selected="true"] { border-color: var(--text, #f4f1ea); box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35); } .ds-pad:hover { filter: brightness(1.06); } .ds-pad:active { transform: scale(0.97); filter: brightness(0.92); } .ds-pad:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #ffe14a); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-nicks { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; } .ds-nick { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; min-height: 56px; padding: 8px 14px; border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: 0 8px 18px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.28); font-family: Sora, "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 800; } .ds-nick[aria-current="true"] { box-shadow: 0 8px 18px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.28), 0 0 0 3px var(--cta, #ffe14a); } .ds-nick-name { min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-nick-pts { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 1.12rem; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; } .ds-nick:hover { filter: brightness(1.04); }

components.css: .ds-turn { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 10px; color: var(--cta, #ffe14a); font-family: Anton, sans-serif; font-size: clamp(2.6rem, 11vw, 3.6rem); font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.01em; text-transform: uppercase; line-height: 0.9; } .ds-turn-dot { width: 22px; height: 22px; border-radius: 50%; flex: 0 0 22px; margin-top: 0.28em; } .ds-turn-copy { flex: 1; min-width: 0; } .ds-turn-copy small { display: block; font-family: Sora, "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0; text-transform: none; color: var(--muted, #b7c4ea); margin-top: 2px; } .ds-timer { position: relative; width: 96px; height: 96px; flex: 0 0 96px; } .ds-timer svg { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; } .ds-timer-track { fill: none; stroke: var(--line, #3a5290); stroke-width: 7; } .ds-timer-arc { fill: none; stroke: var(--cta, #ffe14a); stroke-width: 7; stroke-linecap: round; } .ds-timer-num { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-family: Anton, sans-serif; font-size: 2.35rem; letter-spacing: 0.02em; line-height: 1; color: var(--cta, #ffe14a); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-timer-num small { font-family: Sora, "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0; margin-left: 1px; margin-top: 0.45em; }

narrative.overview:
Tracinhos is a category-standard party-game lobby executed at Kahoot craft: oversized actions, an unmissable turn, and a nick list that reads as people in the room. The field is a night living-room navy; the board is the paper table; electric yellow is the shout that starts a match and owns your turn. It refuses a timid dark-card stack and refuses school, notebook, or lined-paper costume.

Sora carries every UI sentence. Anton is reserved for the shout — wordmark, room code, SUA VEZ / Vez de X, timer numerals, and the result title. Controls sit directly on the navy field. The only lifted object in play is the paper board.
keyCharacteristics: Navy field with a ceiling wash; no nested cards
Electric yellow on primary actions and SUA VEZ, never as a player pad
Eight player colors as fat pads and full-bleed nick tiles
Paper board as the table, with the deepest lift
Color is never the only identity or turn signal

rules.name: The Electric Shout Rule
rules.body: Electric yellow starts the match and owns SUA VEZ. It never fills a player pad and never paints the navy field.

rules.name: The Fat Pad Rule
rules.body: Player color is a filled rounded pad or a full-bleed nick tile — never a thin swatch, outline chip, or text-only tint.

rules.name: The Never-Color-Alone Rule
rules.body: Identity and turn always carry nick, and turn also carries 👈 plus aria-current. Color is a partner, not the signal.

rules.name: The Anton Shout Rule
rules.body: Anton is wordmark, room code, section shout, SUA VEZ / Vez de X, timer numerals, and VENCEU / EMPATE. Every other sentence is Sora.

rules.name: The No Nested Cards Rule
rules.body: Controls sit on the navy field. No card wraps a card; no dark panel stacks the lobby.

rules.name: The Paper Lift Rule
rules.body: The board is the only deeply lifted object. Nick tiles get a short drop. The navy field stays flat.

rules.name: The Fat Radius Rule
rules.body: Actions 20px, pads 16px, fields 14px. Do not square them; do not pill the primary button.

dos: Do shout SUA VEZ in Anton + electric yellow, with a Sora hint underneath.
Do fill pads and nick tiles from the eight player hexes; pair every color with a nick.
Do keep the paper board as the only table on the navy field.
Do size the primary action at 72px (92px for desktop Criar) in electric yellow.
donts: Don't wrap the lobby in nested dark cards or a timid card stack.
Don't dress any surface as school, notebook, or lined paper.
Don't set UI sentences in Anton, or the wordmark / code / SUA VEZ in Sora.
Don't use electric yellow as a player pad, or player yellow as the CTA.
Don't mark identity or turn with color alone.
Don't add kickers, eyebrows, or a results eyebrow.
